o1: Enables GTP binding activity; GTPase activating protein binding activity; and GTPase activity. Involved in actomyosin structure organization; regulation of the actomyosin cytoskeleton; embryonic body morphogenesis; establishment or maintenance of cell polarity; establishment of embryonic polarity; positive regulation of acetylcholine secretion, neurotransmission; and regulation of actin filament-based process. Is located in cell cortex and cleavage furrow. Is expressed in germ line. Is part of let-502/mel-11 pathway; embryonic elongation pathway; Rho protein signal transduction pathway; and Wnt/planar cell polarity signaling pathway. Interacts with LET-502; ECT-2; and RGA-2. Predicted to interact with LET-502. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in breast carcinoma. Orthologous to several human genes including RHOA (ras homolog family member A).
